connectionBusyTakeover: Another device is connected to this desktop. Taking over will disconnect that device.
clipboardUpgrade: Update Cindy on your phone and computer to transfer images and rich text.
clipboardTooLong: Clipboard content is too large. Reduce its size and try again.
clipboardCopyFailed: Could not copy. Check the selected text or computer clipboard and try again.
clipboardPasteFailed: Could not paste. Make sure remote control is available and try again.
mouseWheel: Middle click; hold and drag to scroll
permissionsIntro: Screen recording lets you view the desktop. Accessibility also enables control. Complete authorization on the computer; status updates automatically.
permissionsReady: System permissions are ready. You can reconnect.
screenRecordingHelp: Open System Settings and enable screen recording for this Cindy app. If macOS asks you to restart, reopen Cindy before connecting.
accessibilityHelp: Open settings and enable accessibility for the app identified by the system prompt. The actual input permission is checked automatically when you return.
permissionActionFailed: Could not open the permission guide. Try again in Remote control settings on the computer.
permissionCheckFailed: Could not check permissions. Make sure the computer is online and try again.
permissionGuideOpened: The permission guide is open on the computer. Continue there.
title: Remote desktop
allowHint: Allow your signed-in devices to view and operate all apps on this computer. Also enable device control above.
permissionHint: On the computer, allow screen recording and accessibility in system settings, then reconnect.
upgrade: Update Cindy on the computer to use remote desktop.
disabled: On the computer, enable remote desktop in Settings → Remote control.
busy: Desktop input is busy. Release control on the other device or wait for the Agent action to finish.
connectionBusy: Another device is connected to this remote desktop. Exit remote desktop on that device, then try connecting again.
connectionError: Connection ended. Check that the computer is online, then reconnect.
gestureHint: Pinch to zoom. Two fingers scroll; Move view pans. Hold, then move to drag.
touchHint: Tap to click, hold to drag. Two fingers scroll; pinch to zoom.
pointerHint: Slide to move the pointer, tap to click. Two fingers scroll; pinch to zoom.
panHint: Slide to move the view; pinch to zoom. Turn off to restore your input mode.
viewOnlyHint: View only is on. Slide to move the view or pinch to zoom without controlling the computer.
qualityHint: Auto adapts to the network. Clear, HD and Original cap bitrate at 2, 8 and 20 Mbps. Actual frame rate depends on the computer and network.
settingUnsupported: This computer does not support this setting yet
retrySettings: Could not load. Tap to retry.
resolutionHint: Changes the computer’s display resolution and window layout, then briefly reconnects.
resolutionControlHint: Take control to change the resolution.
videoSettingsFailed: Live video is unavailable. Compatibility viewing does not apply frame rate, quality or sound settings. Select a setting again to retry.
settingFailed: Could not apply the setting. Please retry.
audioUnavailable: Sound is temporarily unavailable for this connection. Your preference is saved. Turn sound off and on to retry.
pipUnavailable: Picture in picture is unavailable. Keep Cindy open to view the desktop.
clipboardUnsupported: This clipboard content is not supported yet. Copy a single image, text, or link. Files and app-specific formats cannot be transferred yet.
